notes.title: Playtest end
notes.notes:
hello everyone

We are deeply grateful for your participation in the playtest of Estate Empire.
Thank you for being an integral part of this journey. We look forward to bringing you the final version of Estate Empire, and we hope you continue to enjoy the game.

Metaway Studio.

notes.title: Problem Solved !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are pleased to inform you that the issue with the playtest launch has been resolved. As a result, the playtest has been extended until July 24th. 
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Enjoy the game!

Metaway Studio.

notes.title: Playtest launch problem
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It seems there is an issue with the launch of the playtest, and we are currently working with Steam to resolve it. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we address this problem.

Thank you for your support,

Metaway Studio.

notes.title: Playtest has started !
notes.notes:
Hello,

The playtest is officially open and will last until July 22nd.

If you need support or want to share your experience with us, you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/mKmgta9cM8]Discord[/url]. If you discover a bug while in-game, you will find a button in the pause menu to report it.

Thank you for participating in this playtest; it means a lot to us.

Metaway Studio.

notes.title: New Playtest !
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the playtest for Estate Empire, running from [b]July 16th to 22nd[/b]. This is an exciting opportunity for you to dive into the game, explore its features, and provide valuable feedback that will help shape its final release.

[h2]During this period, you will have the chance to:[/h2]

- Experience exclusive early gameplay
- Interact with our development team
- Share your insights and suggestions
- Your participation is crucial in making Estate Empire the best it can be.

We can't wait to hear your thoughts and see you in the game!

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm.

Warm regards,

Metaway Studio
